name: Camp Waukeela
description_short: Overnight summer camp for girls in Eaton Center, New Hampshire, running since 1922. It offers two sessions of about 3½ weeks, a full summer, and 2-week sessions for first-time campers only.
refund_policy_summary: You pay a $1,000 registration fee to sign up. It is fully refundable until January 31. Siblings (2nd, 3rd or 4th child) get 10% off the registration fee.

sources.note: Drafted by the listing tool from this page

source.title: Join Our Family at Camp Waukeela | Registration, Pricing & Session Info

warnings: The 2-week Session B (July 5–18) overlaps Session A (June 24–July 7) by three days. This could be a typo on the page, so check it with the camp.
The only address listed is a PO Box (PO 265, Eaton Center, NH), which is a mailing address. The camp's physical location is not given.
The weekdays listed match calendar year 2027, so the session dates are recorded with the year 2027.
Some activities (swimming, hiking, theater) come only from parent testimonials, not from the camp's own program description.

Optional extras cost more on top of tuition: horseback riding ($800 for 5 lessons in a 3½-week session, $500 for 3 lessons in a 2-week session), rock climbing ($300 per session), a bedding package for international campers ($200), and airport transfers from Boston Logan or Portland, ME ($200 each way).
